typography.instructions: Install via standard imports. Headings must have tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.04em). Never use Inter for headings. Use varying font weights (e.g., font-light vs font-black) to create tension.

visual_enhancers.border_radius: 0px or maximum 4px for a sharp, architectural enterprise feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use crisp 1px borders (border-border) instead of soft shadows. For interactive elements, use sharp, offset architectural shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle, clean aesthetics. Let the typography and grid create the texture.

layouts.general: Optical alignment over geometrical. Use very generous spacing (py-24, py-32). Implement a 12-column grid system globally to reflect the 'Duodecimal' (base-12) brand identity.
layouts.hero: Kinetic large typography, max width containers, min-h-[90vh]. Include a subtle parallax image/3D abstract on the right or as a background overlay.
layouts.services: Dense, architectural Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12) where items span 3, 4, or 6 columns. Use 1px borders separating items. Sharp edges.
layouts.about: Numbered manifesto style ('01', '02'). Text heavy, huge font sizes for key statements.
layouts.industries: Vertical accordions or overlapping architectural cards.
layouts.marquee: Slow editorial marquee. Low contrast (e.g., #F8FAFC bg, #64748B text), wide spacing (gap-32) between items. Use react-fast-marquee.
layouts.admin: Shadcn-based dense layout, minimal styling, focused on data clarity.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal. Wrap text in div with overflow-hidden, animate inner text from y: 100% to 0 using framer-motion with an easeOut cubic-bezier.
motion.scrolling: Install and configure @studio-freight/lenis (or lenis) for momentum scrolling across the marketing pages.
motion.scroll_reveals: Framer motion whileInView triggers. Fade + slight Y translation (30px) on scroll.
motion.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform for a slow Y-axis translation on the hero image.

components_to_use: Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea, Button (Contact Form)
Shadcn Table, Card, Badge, DropdownMenu (Admin Enquiries)

hero_abstract.description: Abstract architectural glass, reflecting modern enterprise.

services_abstract.description: Geometric modern abstract for Cloud/AI service.
Monochrome texture for Custom Software service.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute all UI/UX rules from E1.
Do NOT use standard rounded cards for the marketing site. Use sharp corners (0px or 4px max) to achieve the 'Unisys/Duodecimal' enterprise architecture feel.
Implement a globally available sticky navigation with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) that features a sharp 1px bottom border. DO NOT use complete transparent background in header.
For the hero section, use Framer Motion to create a kinetic, masked line-by-line text reveal. The text must come up from below an invisible mask.
Use lenis for smooth scrolling. Wrap the main App or marketing pages in a Lenis provider.
Implement an editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee. It must be slow, large outline text or subtle serif text, breaking up sections.
Build an Admin View (e.g. /admin route or a toggle) using Shadcn components (Table, Data Table) to view mocked form enquiries.
Store contact form submissions in local state or a mocked DB array, and render them in the Admin view.
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, buttons, and critical UI elements.
Use sharp, thin borders (border-slate-200) to create a 'blueprint/grid' aesthetic across the Services and Industries sections.
DO NOT center-align paragraphs. Keep text left-aligned for maximum readability.
Ensure the hero has a subtle parallax effect on the image.
universal_guidelines: Never use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through z-index and architectural borders rather than drop shadows.
Do not apply global transitions (e.g., transition: all).
All interactive elements must have hover and focus states with sufficient contrast.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text.
